photo.no_place: There is no place {place_id} (no file {file}). Check the id, run stage 5c first, or git pull.
photo.full: This place already has {max} photos. If one of them is wrong, remove it first (--remove N), then add the right one.
photo.too_big: Too big ({size} MB). The most is 20 MB: save a smaller copy and try again.
photo.download_failed: Couldn't download this link ({reason}). Open it in your browser: if the photo shows, right-click it → Save image as, then add the saved file.
photo.web_page: This is a web page link, not a photo. Right-click the photo → Copy image address, and paste that link.
photo.unreadable: Can't read this image ({reason}). Use a JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo.
photo.too_small: Too small ({width}×{height} px): it will look blurry. Find one at least {min} px on each side.
photo.duplicate: This photo is already on this place (photo {number}).
photo.upload_failed: Upload failed ({reason}). Check the internet, then try again.
photo.no_keys: The Cloudinary keys are not in .env (see README, Setup), so the photo can't be uploaded.
photo.bad_source: source must be one of: {sources}, or "Other: <where>". Not {source}.
photo.no_credit: credit is needed: who took or posted the photo (e.g. the Google Maps user's name, or the shop's page name).
photo.changed: {file} changed while the photo was uploading (someone else saved it?). Nothing was added: git pull, then add the photo again.
photo.bad_number: There is no photo {number} (this place has {count}).
photo.removed: {place_id}: removed photo {number} ({url}). The picture stays on Cloudinary.
photo.moved: {place_id}: photo {number} is now photo {to}. Photo 1 is the main one.
photo.remove_ask: Remove photo {number} of {place_id} ({url}, credit: {credit})? Type yes:
check.not_list: photos must be a list [...], not {value}
check.too_many: {count} photos: the most is {max}. Remove some (python stage5d_add_photo.py {place_id} --remove N)
check.bad_url: photo {number}: url must be an https:// link, not {value}
check.bad_source: photo {number}: source must be one of: {sources}, or "Other: <where>". Not {value}
check.no_credit: photo {number}: credit is empty (who took or posted the photo?)
check.same_photo: photo {number} is the same picture as photo {other}: remove one
cli.next_more: Next: add {need} more photo(s) the same way (at least 1 is needed to publish), then check: python stage5d_check_photos.py
cli.next_check: Next: python stage5d_check_photos.py, then commit and push data/places/
checker.need: need photos ({count}): new places, at least 1 photo to publish
checker.next_add: Add photos: python stage5d_add_photo.py <place_id> <photo file or image link> --source "Google Maps" --credit "<who posted it>"
checker.cant_read: Can't read {reason}. Fix it (or git pull). Nothing changed.
